note: Brand file schema with neutral values. Copy to film/brand.json (or pass --brand <file>, set FILM_BRAND, or name it in the storyboard's "brand") and change what differs; every key is optional and falls back to the value shown here (the defaults in lib/config.mjs). Paths are relative to this file; ${NAME} expands an environment variable. See film/README.md, section Brand.
name: Acme

look.note: Layout. aspect picks the canvas (16:9 1920x1080, 9:16 1080x1920, 1:1 1080x1080; --aspect or FILM_ASPECT override it) and every layout number is derived from it and from the take's viewport (docs/LOOK.md lists them per aspect). 9:16 needs a phone-preset take unless allowLetterbox is true. bezel: "auto" draws a neutral device frame around a phone take, false never, true always. Any derived number can still be set here (film, capture, window, band, camera, caption, tag, type, pointer, wipe, cards), but a fixed window or canvas no longer follows the aspect, so set them only for one deliberate layout.
